source_text: A safety sensor must be present within 2 m of the cell opening.
rationale: An unguarded cell opening lets a person enter the robot envelope without tripping a protective stop.
unsupported_reason: Presence-required semantics: when no safety sensor is detected the engine abstains with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, which silently converts the violation this rule exists to catch (no sensor at all) into a non-verdict; max_separation only grades sensors already found. 'cell opening' is also not a perception class, so the reference object cannot be located.
